body.purpose: Story prose; local variants remain in source.

motion.name: rotation-release
motion.value: response .4; damping .8 when release velocity exceeds .1; otherwise 1

components.name: Primary action
components.html: Explore my work
components.css: :host{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-button-primary{ display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 21px; min-height: 46px; border-radius: 30px; padding: 13px 21px; background: var(--blue,#0068d7); color: white; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 150ms,transform 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),box-shadow 180ms; }.ds-button-primary:hover{ background: #005fc5; box-shadow: 0 5px 14px #0068d71c; }.ds-button-primary:active{ transform: scale(.97); }.ds-button-primary svg{ transition: transform 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); }.ds-button-primary:hover svg{ transform: translateX(2px); }.contact-inner>.ds-button-primary{ margin-top: 30px; }.ds-button-primary{font-optical-sizing:auto;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue,#0068d7);outline-offset:5px;}@media(max-width:1050px){.ds-button-primary{font-size:.75rem;padding:12px 17px;gap:12px}}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-button-primary{padding:12px 18px;min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}a{text-decoration:none}

narrative.overview:
A light, spacious personal portfolio in the confirmed Apple-inspired visual world. White and cool porcelain keep graphite typography, restrained blue actions, and authored spatial studies in focus. Platform typography is an explicit design commitment.

Content sits flush in generous margins. Functional translucent navigation maintains context while scrolling; rounded controls and quiet tonal stages frame direct manipulation. WebGL and inline SVG supply imagery; the city is a photo-derived reconstruction with estimated dimensions.

rules.name: The Context Rule
rules.body: Translucency belongs to the sticky navigation chrome and yields to the user's transparency and contrast preferences.

rules.name: The Motion Preference Rule
rules.body: Reduced motion and the manual animation switch remove decorative movement and settle state changes directly. The ThreeUI clock pauses while disabled, offscreen, or in a hidden document; city rendering runs only while needed. The snippets below represent source HTML/CSS states; JavaScript spring and WebGL behavior remains in the source components.

dos: Do use blue for actions and keyboard focus.
Do label estimated model dimensions and interpreted geometry.
Do preserve reduced-motion, reduced-transparency, and increased-contrast treatments.
Do use authored SVG geometry for interface icons.
donts: Don't restore the replaced graphite/lime identity.
Don't add tickers, section numbers, neon, or fake trademarks.
Don't claim the photo-derived model has measured dimensions or fabrication accuracy.
